headline: Malvinas: Argentine pressure causes "losses" in oil project
summary: Argentina's foreign ministry welcomed the withdrawal of two contractors from the oil project. The UK maintains support for companies in the project and is preparing tools to protect them from sanctions.
why: Offshore oil developments in the Falklands depend on contractors and licences, and sanctions risk can affect project costs and timelines.
original_headline: Malvinas: presión argentina causa “bajas” en proyecto petrolero
